Website · Discord · English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · Italiano · 日本語 · Bahasa Indonesia · Português (Brasil)

Tiny engine, immense model. colibri runs very large open models on the machine you already have. A mixture-of-experts model of hundreds of billions of parameters uses only a small part of itself for each token, so colibri keeps that part in RAM and reads the rest, the experts, from the disk when the model asks for them. Pure C, one file per model family, no GPU required.

Thirteen engines run today. Ten are for language models: GLM-5.2/5.3 (which also runs Mistral-Large-4 ), GLM-5.3-Flash , Inkling , Kimi K3 , DeepSeek V4 Flash , DeepSeek V4.1 Flash , MiMo-V2.6 Flash (and Pro), Qwen3.8-Flash-Next , Qwen3.6 (which also runs Qwen3-Coder, the dense Qwen3.8-27B, Flint , Muse Spark Open and LFM3-VL ) and OLMoE . One draws pictures: Qwen-Image-2.1 . Two answer decisions: Laya and GLiNER2.5-Decide , with a third decision model, Clef , on the Qwen3.6 engine. The language models also run from the GGUF files already published, read as they are (GGUF), on the CPU, on any GPU through Vulkan and on NVIDIA cards through CUDA. Which one for my machine

It is also a way of working with an agent: take as little human attention as possible, and give as much value as possible. An agent that can act for a whole team can also waste a whole team's attention, so it acts only when asked or when a rule the team wrote allows it, and speaks only when someone must act or can use a result. docs/000-philosophy.md explains the principle and what it asks of the operator.

items.name: sandcastle
items.description: Orchestrate sandboxed coding agents in TypeScript with sandcastle.run()

readme.excerpt:
A TypeScript library for orchestrating AI coding agents in isolated sandboxes:

1. You invoke agents with a single sandcastle.run() . 2. Sandcastle handles sandboxing the agent with a configurable branch strategy. 3. The commits made on the branches get merged back.

Sandcastle is provider-agnostic. It ships with native sandboxes that use your OS's own process sandbox (Bubblewrap on Linux and WSL2, Seatbelt on macOS), image-based providers for Docker and Podman, and cloud providers for Daytona, E2B, Fly.io Sprites, Modal and Vercel, and you can create your own. Great for parallelizing multiple AFK agents, creating review pipelines, or even just orchestrating your own agents.

items.description: Mutual-credit coordination for contributing spare LLM subscription capacity through GitHub issues and pull requests.

readme.excerpt:
You spent Tuesday evening fixing someone else's flaky test. The bug in your own tracker just turned eleven months old. You had time to help then. You need help now. What if that Tuesday could pay for it?

Let your spare weeks pay for the dry ones. Overflow is a shared ledger for open-source work, for people and small teams whose capacity comes and goes. When you have leftover LLM subscription usage that you won't burn on your own projects, work on others' issues and earn credit. Spend it on your own backlog when you're depleted. No money changes hands. There is no token.

平时我们用 Claude Code、Codex 这类命令行 Agent，大多是“人守着终端用”：你输一句话，盯着它跑，等它问你下一步；一旦关掉窗口或者人走开，事情就断了。

Agent Autoloop 是一个极轻量的自动化中台。它把任务调度做成一个零外部依赖的 内核 ，把事件来源、Agent、通知通道，甚至代码上线流水线全部拆成可随时插拔的 插件 。

- 一台电脑、一条命令就能跑。 装在你的 Mac 或 Linux 上，不用买云服务器，也不用开放公网端口。 - 一行配置接新 Agent。 不需要 SDK，也不需要改 Agent 源码，能接收提示词并打印最后一条回复的命令行工具都能接。 - 没有后台界面。 需要你拍板时把卡片推到飞书、钉钉、企微、Slack、Discord 或桌面通知；想看全局进展，敲一行命令。
features: 一台电脑、一条命令就能跑。 装在你的 Mac 或 Linux 上，不用买云服务器，也不用开放公网端口。
一行配置接新 Agent。 不需要 SDK，也不需要改 Agent 源码，能接收提示词并打印最后一条回复的命令行工具都能接。
没有后台界面。 需要你拍板时把卡片推到飞书、钉钉、企微、Slack、Discord 或桌面通知；想看全局进展，敲一行命令。
新事件进来。 早上 9 点的定时任务、GitHub 上新提的 Issue、业务系统报的错，都变成一条标准事件送进内核。
按规则派活。 内核照你写的规则，决定交给哪个 Agent、去哪个目录干。同一件事排队时又来的消息，会合并成一轮处理。
干完一轮就退出。 Agent 把结果写在最后一条回复里，进程直接退出。
拿不准才问你。 碰到删数据、重启服务、花钱、对外发消息这类事，内核通过飞书或桌面通知发一张卡片给你。等你回复期间，它不占后台进程，也不消耗 Token。
点一下，接着干。 你选完，它接上原来的对话，把剩下的活干完。

items.name: Kingfisher
items.description: A lightweight, pure-Swift library for downloading and caching images from the web.

readme.excerpt:
Kingfisher is a powerful, pure-Swift library for downloading and caching images from the web. It provides you a chance to use a pure-Swift way to work with remote images in your next app.

- [x] Asynchronous image downloading and caching. - [x] Loading image from either URLSession -based networking or local provided data. - [x] Useful image processors and filters provided. - [x] Multiple-layer hybrid cache for both memory and disk. - [x] Fine control on cache behavior. Customizable expiration date and size limit. - [x] Opt-in async cache probing in KingfisherManager to avoid blocking the caller thread on disk cache checks. - [x] Cancelable downloading and auto-reusing previous downloaded content to improve performance. - [x] Independent components. Use the downloader, caching system, and image processors separately as you need. - [x] Prefetching images and showing them from the cache to boost your app. - [x] Extensions for UIImageView , NSImageView , NSButton , UIButton , NSTextAttachment , WKInterfaceImage , TVMonogramView and CPListItem to directly set an image from a URL. - [x] Built-in transition animation when setting images. - [x] Customizable placeholder and indicator while loading images. - [x] Extensible image processing and image format easily. - [x] Low Data Mode support. - [x] SwiftUI support. - [x] Swift 6 & Swift Concurrency (strict mode) prepared. - [x] Load & cache for Live Photo.

The simplest use-case is setting an image to an image view with the UIImageView

Herdr is a desktop app for terminals and coding agents. Keep work in spaces, see which agents need you, and leave terminals running when you close the window.

curl -fsSL https://releases.herdr.dev/app/install.sh sh

readme.excerpt:
Command-line and GUI tools for producing Java source code from Android Dex and APK files

Main features: - decompile Dalvik bytecode to Java code from APK, dex, aab, apks, apkm, xapk and zip files - also decompile Java bytecode (jar, class, aar) and smali files - decode AndroidManifest.xml and other resources from resources.arsc - deobfuscator included

jadx-gui features: - view decompiled code with syntax highlighting - jump to declaration - find usage - full-text search - smali debugger, see the wiki page for setup and usage
